chains.frame: Which word best describes Yara’s response when asked to help?

beats.text: When asked to dry the dishes, Yara shrugged and said she was far too tired to get up from the sofa.
beats.decisive_clue: feigned exhaustion to avoid simple effort
beats.reason: The detail about feigned exhaustion to avoid simple effort supports indolent more strongly than insolent.

beats.text: When reminded again, she sneered, “Do it yourself, since you seem so desperate to feel useful.”
beats.reason: The detail about openly insulting reply supports insolent more strongly than indolent.

chains.feedback_short: Openly insulting reply makes insolent the better description.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, feigned exhaustion to avoid simple effort points toward indolent. The new detail, openly insulting reply, instead makes insolent the stronger choice. Indolent behaviour avoids effort out of laziness; insolent behaviour openly disrespects someone.
chains.contrast_rule: Indolent avoids work; insolent shows disrespect.
